headline_marked: Messi claims [[Argentina received no special favors]] to reach final
headline: Messi claims Argentina received no special favors to reach final
summary: The football legend denies allegations of unfair advantages, attributing the team's success to their own hard work and ability.
details: Lionel Messi has dismissed claims that the Argentina national team received special treatment or advantages to secure their place in the final.
The star forward stated that the team reached the final based on their own merits and capabilities, rather than any external help.
Messi emphasized that the squad's journey to the championship match was a result of their collective effort and dedication.
This statement comes amid discussions regarding the fairness of the tournament and the team's performance leading up to the final.
caption:
No special favors. Lionel Messi speaks out against claims of unfair advantages for Argentina.

Lionel Messi has dismissed claims that the Argentina national team received special treatment or advantages to secure their place in the final.

Messi emphasized that the squad's journey to the championship match was a result of their collective effort and dedication.

This statement comes amid discussions regarding the fairness of the tournament and the team's performance leading up to the final.

headline_marked: Mymensingh: [[Train derails]], rail communication restored after 3 hours
headline: Mymensingh: Train derails, rail communication restored after 3 hours
summary: A train derailment in Mymensingh caused a temporary disruption in rail services, which took three hours to normalize.
details: A train derailed in Mymensingh, causing a sudden halt to rail traffic in the area.
The incident led to a temporary disruption of rail communication, affecting passengers and schedules.
Railway authorities worked quickly to address the situation and clear the tracks.
Normal rail services were restored approximately three hours after the derailment occurred.
caption:
A train derailment in Mymensingh disrupted rail services for three hours.
